results.message_text: Hi Nidhi — I’m building ZapPay, a zero-wait fuel payments layer for India’s petrol pumps. We’re starting with a 10–20 pump pilot and targeting a category that can scale across 85k+ outlets. Given your investing focus, I’d love to share why we believe ZapPay can become core payments infrastructure for fuel retail in India. Would you be open to a short conversation as we open our seed round?
